Name: AlterOphelie's Character Overhaul
Author: alterophelie
Description:
[b][size=5][center]AlterOphelie's Complete Character Overhaul[/center][/size][/b]Hey guys! Here is my complete portrait mod. This mod replaces the portraits of every character in the game with my own redesigned portraits. The goal when creating this mod was to draw each character in a more realistic style while retaining the personality and expressiveness of the original portraits. 

The Bachelorettes:


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ac01oks.png[/img]


The Bachelors:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xHXTtg1.png[/img]


The Villagers:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6bbzGGj.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/l8S3xkA.png[/img]


In the future I plan on updating this mod with sprite edits, so that the character sprites more closely match the portraits. 
Please let me know if you experience any issues installing the mod, or if any weirdness happens while using this mod. Enjoy!

[b]UPDATE

[/b]A few of the characters have been edited. Alex has received a total redraw, and several others have some minor edits to smooth things out. The mod file "AlterOphelie's Character Overhaul" now reflects this. If you downloaded the previous version and don't feel like redownloading the whole thing, I have provided an optional file called "AlterOphelie's Edited Characters" that just replaces the portraits that have been revisited.

[b]HOW TO INSTALL:
[/b](Always back up your files before installing mods!)

1. Unzip file
2. Place Portraits folder in Stardew Valley Content directory. For Steam games this is typically C://Program Files/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Content
3. Select "yes" for any overwrite prompts
